about_the_game:
Step into the underground world of forbidden trade with this free demo of Backrooms Blackmarket. Experience the thrill of exploring the Backrooms, collecting rare objects, and selling them for profit—all while avoiding the unseen dangers lurking in the shadows.

What’s included in this demo:

🔹 Explore the first three levels of the Backrooms, each filled with unique loot and increasing risks.
🔹 Gather and sell items to get a taste of the in-game economy and upgrade potential.
🔹 Use a basic teleporter with limited energy—time your exits carefully!
🔹 Encounter environmental hazards and strange anomalies—but not all the entities from the full game.
🔹 Limited inventory management system—choose wisely what you take back with you.
🔹 Simple upgrade progression to improve your efficiency and survivability.

💡 This demo provides a preview of the core mechanics but does not represent the full game experience. Some advanced features, deeper levels, and high-tier upgrades are not available in this version.

Supported Features in This Demo:

✅ Single-player mode (no multiplayer features)
✅ English language support (full localization available in the full game)
✅ Basic sound design and environmental effects (not final)

🚫 The following features are only available in the full game:

  • Additional Backrooms levels and deeper lore

  • Advanced upgrade systems and expanded inventory slots

  • Full AI-driven entity behaviors

  • More entities

  • More diverse item trading mechanics

Explore, Loot, and Escape

The government has banned all civilian access to the Backrooms after a wave of disappearances and fatal accidents. But that hasn’t stopped people like you. Armed with a stolen teleporter, you can slip inside—if you're fast enough. Time is your enemy. The longer you stay, the more the Backrooms start to notice you.

Upgrade Your Operation

Use your earnings to expand your inventory, acquire better tools, and unlock access to even more dangerous levels. A bigger haul means bigger profits, but it also means greater risks. Light sources, motion detectors, and faster teleporters could mean the difference between life and death.

You Are Not Alone

Shadows move where they shouldn't. Whispers follow your footsteps. Strange entities roam these empty halls, watching, waiting. If you’re not careful, you won’t be coming back.

Get in, grab what you can, and get out—before something finds you.
